If you appreciate the flair of a celebrity chef, Bobby Flay's Bar Americain here in the Casino of the Earth is our standout spot for bold, regional flavors. The menu is inspired by American brasserie classics but infused with Bobby’s signature Southwest spice—the crunch and heat in his dishes are legendary. It is open today from 11:30 AM until 10:00 PM, and while it is great for a casual lunch, I'd suggest a reservation if you're coming for dinner in your smart casual attire.

Insider tip: Bobby Flay is known for his love of bold textures, so I suggest trying any dish that features his signature spice rubs or sauces, as they really tie the whole meal together. Please keep in mind that hours and prices may vary, so it's best to confirm with the property.

Since you are here today, you might enjoy the live music at the Wolf Den nearby after you eat; it is right in the heart of the Casino of the Earth and always has a great energy. The char from the coal-fired oven gives that thin crust a perfect crunch that guests travel from all over the state to experience. They are open right now until 10:00 PM, and since it’s casual, you can just walk right in without a reservation. 

Their white clam pie is a national icon, but honestly, even a simple tomato pie there is something special because they've been perfecting that recipe since 1925.
